scoring_justification: Recomputing the octahedral rotation angle from raw atomic positions is infeasible because the agent outputs only the final angle; the checker ensures consistency with the paper-reported experimental rotation angle (6.3±0.5°) and the formation energy difference threshold (|ΔΩ| ≤ 0.1 eV) derived from the paper's negligible strain-dependence claim.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for rotation angle (6.3°) and formation energy difference threshold (0.1 eV)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: rotation angle experimental value ~6.3° (Fig.1, dashed line); formation energy difference for −2% compressive strain is ~75 meV increase, deemed negligible (≤0.1 eV).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and Fig.1; threshold set to accept the reported 75 meV spread and comparable values within DFT reproducibility.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly traceable to the source paper's reported experimental reference and central claim.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the oxygen octahedral rotation angle (degrees).

outputs.description: The computed octahedral rotation angle is compared to the experimental reference with a hidden tolerance.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the formation energy difference ΔΩ (eV).

outputs.description: The absolute value of the formation energy difference is verified to be ≤ a hidden threshold derived from the paper’s negligible change claim.

output_contract.notes: Both artifacts are read by the checker; the agent must produce them at the specified paths. The rotation angle is scored by closeness to the experimental value; the formation energy difference is scored by whether its absolute value falls below the acceptable limit.
